headline: Career Projects, from entry to detail
overview: Manage career and business projects with team tracking, org charts, and milestone management. Keep your professional projects organized and aligned with your long-term career goals.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Career Projects — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the career projects list with project status, team members, and milestone tracking.
steps.screenshotAlt: Career Projects landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Manage career and business projects with status tracking
Track team members and roles with org chart visualization
Set and monitor project milestones and deliverables
Connect projects to your career goals for strategic alignment
tips: Add projects as you take them on — even side projects and personal initiatives — to build a comprehensive career portfolio.
Link each project to a career goal so you can see how your day-to-day work connects to your long-term ambitions.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
